new_destinations.name: Yasawa Islands
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre of the named place/region (town centre or middle of its spots); to be confirmed with resolve-pin.py

name_evidence.wording: Wikivoyage page "Yasawa Islands" (island chain north of the Mamanucas; Blue Lagoon, Sawa-i-Lau).

spots.name: Sawa-i-Lau Caves
spots.bio_draft: Cave: limestone sea caves on Sawa-i-Lau islet off the southern tip of Yasawa Island, swum into by boat trip (one reached by an underwater passage, daylight in the largest cave); the cave trip Wikivoyage lists under Do. Tourism board page seen in search only (fetch blocked).
spots.reason: Inside the span of Yasawa Islands and reached from that base.

spots.name: Blue Lagoon
spots.bio_draft: Beach and snorkel lagoon on the west side of Nanuya Lailai, the film location of The Blue Lagoon (1980); a fish sanctuary with coral, reached on Blue Lagoon Cruises day trips. Wikivoyage: the real Blue Lagoon is privately owned, this is the day-trip beach. No article under this name (the title is a disambiguation page), so views are 0 and a disambiguated wiki title is still needed.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Yasawa Islands and reached from that base.

spots.name: Nanuya Lailai
spots.bio_draft: Island: next to the Blue Lagoon and Turtle Island; Wikivoyage lists a walk over the island with views, the Blue Lagoon snorkel and diving from its dive shop.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Yasawa Islands and reached from that base.

spots.name: Waya Lailai
spots.bio_draft: Island: also called Wayasewa, with a rocky volcanic peak at its centre; Wikivoyage recommends the climb to the top for sunrise, and a three-hour walk across the island to Naboro village.
spots.reason: Inside the span of Yasawa Islands and reached from that base.

review_list_not_placed.name: Manta Ray Snorkel Passage
review_list_not_placed.objection: A passage between islands, not a place with access; Rule 4 timing (May-Oct) and depends on resort alarm
